manifest.name: WASI Counter
manifest.description: A counter in a WASI component: its view drawn by the app, an action that asks the app which themes it has, and a job (counting primes) in a worker while the counter keeps answering.

actions.name: WASI Counter: add one
actions.description: Adds one (or `by`) to the counter; its view shows it.

actions.name: WASI Counter: ask the app
actions.description: Asks the app for its themes (THEME_LIST, through the host service) and shows how many.

actions.name: WASI Counter: count primes
actions.description: Counts the primes below `n` (2,000,000) in a worker, its progress in the view; cancels one running.

actions.name: WASI Counter: the primes job
actions.description: The primes job's state: status, progress, result.
